title: Starmer leads fightback as budget row rumbles on for Reeves
summary: The prime minister is keen to change the conversation after the Tories called his chancellor’s ethics into question The political fates of Keir Starmer and Rachel Reeves are intertwined. Allies say that if one goes, the other is likely to follow. This is why, in the wake of the budget, the Conservatives have attempted to focus their response on the chancellor’s personal ethics , accusing Reeves of lying about the rationale behind her record-breaking tax rises. title: California police search for suspect who killed four and wounded 11 in shooting at child’s party
summary: Victims who died in attack on banquet hall in Stockton were aged eight, nine, 14 and 21, county sheriff’s office says Police are searching for the suspect who killed four people, including three children, and injured 11 in a shooting at a family gathering in Stockton, California , on Saturday night – and they are appealing to the public for any tips people may have. “If you have surveillance footage, if you’re a local business here, if you’re in the area, live in the area, or maybe you’ve heard rumors – please contact the sheriff’s office,” said Heather Brent, a spokesperson for the San Joaquin county sheriff’s office. title: Armed men kidnap 13 women in Nigeria’s latest abduction
summary: A bride, 10 bridesmaids, a baby and two women were kidnapped during a night raid in Sokoto State.
